howToPlay: Use your Super to mark enemies and follow up with basic attacks for extra damage. Gather caterpillars to strengthen your abilities, then use your gadgets to clear areas or heal yourself. Manage your caterpillar collection to effectively utilize your Star Powers.
gears: Equip SPEED to maneuver into range, DAMAGE to boost your offensive output, or SHIELD to survive longer in combat.
trait: This brawler suits players who enjoy tactical resource management and rewarding combo-based combat.
